bio: Nestled on the banks of The River Cam, Graduate Cambridge is an idyllic retreat, surrounded by the historic colleges of this university city.  Following a major refurbishment, Graduate Cambridge is once again welcoming guests to enjoy a traditional Afternoon Tea, in the heart of the city centre.  Afternoon Tea is served in the Garden Room, a quintessentially English experience in a picturesque setting. Guests are welcome to enjoy Afternoon Tea in the riverside garden, weather permitting.  Enjoy a traditional Afternoon Tea menu featuring Smoked Salmon, Roast Beef and Goat’s Cheese sandwiches.  Scones are served with preserves and clotted cream. Sweet treats include Blood Orange & Fennel Pollen Tartlet and Cranberry Doughnuts.  Choose from a selection of Canton teas including English Breakfast, Earl Grey and Phoenix Honey Orchid.  Afternoon Tea costs £29.50 per person or £39.50 per person with a glass of Coates & Seely English Sparkling wine. Vegan and Vegetarian Afternoon Tea menus are also available.
